selection_status: Pending chronological baseline comparisons and source availability audit; no model fitted
scope: Synthetic outage demonstration; no claim of operational PENELCO predictive skill

source.timestamp_normalization: Localize naive source clocks to their recorded zone, then convert to UTC; do not localize UTC as Manila
source.precipitation_semantics: Hourly preceding-interval total precipitation used as rainfall proxy; confirm original provider/model
source.gust_semantics: Maximum over supplied hourly gust values; historical/forecast temporal meanings not yet reconciled

grouping.location_identity: Verified municipal point or ERA5 grid cell; never mix grains or roll across locations
grouping.barangay_join: Compute once per weather location, then join using verified PSGC-to-weather-location mapping

alignment.operational_gate: Every input available_at <= issue_time, required historic interval ends <= fixed cutoff; missing required hours yield null
alignment.trailing_window: Valid-time labels in (c - W hours, c], precipitation intervals collectively (c - W hours, c]
alignment.issue_time_policy: Hourly-aligned for this contract; off-hour interval adapters require a new explicit specification
alignment.forecast_gate: Run initialization and actual publication/availability no later than issue; retain original vintage and valid times

missingness.duplicates: Reject duplicate location/source/valid-time keys; diagnose before calculation
missingness.cadence: Reindex within each group to hourly valid-time grid; leave missing hours null
missingness.window_policy: All expected hourly values required for sums, means, maxima and decay; no zero-fill, interpolation, future backfill or rescaling partial windows
missingness.initial_history: Warm-up produces null, never artificial zeros
missingness.antecedent_policy: Direct disjoint 48-hour window can be valid when recent 24 hours are missing; parent-sum subtraction requires both parents complete
missingness.pressure_policy: Two finite endpoints required, intermediate hours are not constituents of endpoint difference
missingness.snapshot_policy: Require value at exact cutoff, otherwise null; no unbounded carry-forward
missingness.model_imputation: Fit only on training; retain coverage flags; evaluate deployment-compatible missingness

historical_candidates.purpose: Recent storm accumulation and multiday rainfall context
historical_candidates.risk: Nested windows redundant; realized future rainfall and event-end windows prohibited

historical_candidates.purpose: Sustained scalar wind exposure at hourly sampling resolution
historical_candidates.risk: Not a vector mean or continuous-time average; centered windows leak future samples

historical_candidates.purpose: Largest supplied hourly gust in trailing window
historical_candidates.risk: Product-dependent gust semantics; partial windows underestimate peaks; real future gusts leak

historical_candidates.purpose: Earlier wetness distinct from most recent 24h rainfall
historical_candidates.risk: Exactly dependent on R72-R24 when both parent sums complete; not a measured saturation index
Not a subhourly peak or rainfall rate unless explicitly divided by 1h
Release timing and forecast support unverified; not actual local soil saturation
Not validated storm detection; incompatible pressure definitions and future endpoints prohibited
Uncalibrated parameters; ewm.mean is not this sum; tune without final test

forecast_candidates.formula: sum(k=1..H, p_forecast[issue_time+k hours]) from one eligible published vintage
forecast_candidates.risk: No realized future weather; no later revisions; nested totals must not be added together

forecast_candidates.formula: max(k=1..H, g_forecast[issue_time+k hours]) from one eligible published vintage
forecast_candidates.risk: Missing leads yield null; source interval semantics must match training

evaluation_gate.split_policy: Chronological; purge outcome windows crossing boundaries; validation-only choices; final frozen test
evaluation_gate.selection_policy: Retain smallest stable useful available set; identical eligible evaluation rows; no automatic inclusion
